select_java_functions: run the CLI to select simple standalone Java functions from tokenized input files and write deduplicated output
check_uses_ios: check if a Java code string uses file I/O operations like java.io.File or IOException
extract_return_type: extract the return type from a Java function signature string
validate_standalone_func: validate that a Java function is simple, standalone, and compiles successfully with supported types
filter_functions_from_file: filter Java functions from a tokenized file using threaded compilation checks and write selected ones
